card.name: Romanized Japanese particles in example sentences
card.fires_on: Pieces of a romanized Japanese example sentence, mainly the case particle "wo" or "ga" in "John-san-ga Mari-san-ni hon-wo agemashita". It is strongest on "wo" and weaker on nearby parts of the sentence.
